title: Immediate return halts
statement: Let $A$ be a machine with memory, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ be a predicate on machine configurations. If the instruction at control state $l$ is a deterministic return of the Boolean value $r$, and $G$ holds at the configuration with state $l$, register values $v$, no stored result, and memory $[0m\mu$, then the machine halts on $x$ with result $r$ from that configuration, with $G$ holding at every configuration strictly before it halts.
hypotheses_covered: The instruction at $l$ is a deterministic return of $r$
